practice. Such long waits for appointments, and it seems they never have appointments for the same day available. I waited 2 weeks for an appointment for my child for a health condition that affects them daily, and causes us both a lot of distress. I then had this appointment cancelled on the day. When I phoned to rebook at 8:40am when you would assume they should still have some appointments left, they could not give me another appointment until 3 days later.
